name: Scheduled tasks
description: List, create, run, stop, export or delete modern scheduled tasks over WMI. Exact task names only; create refuses tasks found by its preflight check.

name.description: Exact task name; required except for list

path.description: Task folder, e.g. \Maintenance\; actions default to root, list defaults to all folders

executable.description: Create: absolute executable path on the remote host, without surrounding quotes

arguments.description: Create: argument string, separate from executable

working_directory.description: Create: optional absolute remote working directory

account.description: Create: explicitly choose the task service account; no passwords are accepted

schedule.description: Create: default demand (run explicitly); once/daily require start

start.description: Create: ISO datetime with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-11-01T09:00:00-05:00

limit.description: List safety cap; exceeding it fails instead of truncating
